clue.text: Bishop is at home, but not king as well

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: but not tells us to take the king's letter out of the word for living somewhere

parts.note: someone who is at home resides there
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A bishop is staying at home, and the king isn't there with him.
explanation.definitionFit: Besides is an adverb meaning in addition or also, the same sense as as well.

clue.text: Lie by a broken wall

indicators.note: broken tells us these letters are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone lies down beside a crumbling wall.
explanation.walkthrough: A bailey is the outer wall of a castle, or the courtyard it encloses.
explanation.definitionFit: In castles, the bailey is the outer defensive wall around the keep.

clue.text: Succeeded except when gloomy

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, used in family trees
unless means except when

explanation.surface: Someone succeeded, except at times of depression.
explanation.definitionFit: A day without sunshine is dark and dull, so gloomy.

clue.text: One working in order to make small container

parts.note: to do is to make, as in do a drawing
mini means small
a can is a container

explanation.surface: Someone at work, tidying things to produce a little box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' sounds like tidiness; it means a religious order.
explanation.definitionFit: A Dominican is a friar of the Order of Preachers, so one working within a religious order.

clue.text: Sensible to have name in enclosure for response

indicators.note: in means the name letter goes inside the envelope abbreviation

parts.note: an SAE, a stamped addressed envelope, is enclosed with a letter so the recipient can reply

explanation.surface: It is wise to include your name in what you send for a reply.
explanation.walkthrough: SAE, a stamped addressed envelope, is a British convention for getting a reply by post.
explanation.definitionFit: Sane means of sound mind, so sensible or reasonable.

clue.text: Prize paid is to fall sharply

parts.note: a plum is a prize, the most sought-after job or reward
a bill that has been paid has been met

explanation.surface: Winnings that have been paid out are about to drop steeply.
explanation.definitionFit: To plummet is to drop straight down fast, as prices or a falling body do.

clue.text: Tendency to intrude? Launches appeal to stop that

indicators.note: to stop that means the following pieces plug the middle of the nosy word

parts.note: to pry is to intrude nosily
a business that launches opens
it is slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Is the habit nosiness? Someone starts a campaign to end it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tendency to intrude?' looks like the whole definition, but only 'Tendency' defines; 'that' points back to the nosiness the launch and appeal go into.
explanation.definitionFit: A propensity is a natural inclination, a tendency to behave a certain way.

clue.text: Page busy? Time it's turned over

annotationWithheld.clue: Page busy? Time it's turned over

clue.text: Something charged after factory supplies large number

indicators.note: after places the charged particle behind the factory

parts.note: a mill is a factory
an ion is an atom carrying an electrical charge

explanation.surface: Something billed after the factory provides a lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' suggests billing; it is electrical charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A million is a thousand thousands, a big number.

clue.text: Gossip ignoring line with warning to stop being shabby

indicators.note: ignoring means the letter for line is left out of the word for chatter

parts.note: to tattle is to gossip
a red light warns traffic to stop

explanation.surface: A gossip, overlooking the cue to stop talking, becomes tiresome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring' drops one L from TATTLE to give TATTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Tattered clothes are torn and ragged, so shabby.

clue.text: Gesture, first off, threatening to capture island base

indicators.note: first off means the opening letter of the word for a gesture is dropped

parts.note: a sign is a gesture made with the hands

indicators.note: to capture means the word for menacing takes the island letter inside itself

parts.note: something threatening is ominous

explanation.surface: A menacing gesture is made towards seizing an island base.
explanation.definitionFit: Base here means shameful or contemptible, and an ignominious act is one that brings disgrace.

clue.text: Reason for scrubbing service to be hired

definitions.meaning: in tennis a serve that clips the net is called again, so the serve is scrubbed and replayed
a house to ... is available to rent

explanation.walkthrough: In tennis, a serve that touches the net cord and lands in is a let, and it is replayed.
explanation.definitionFit: The tennis call for a replayed serve, and the verb for renting out property, are both spelt the same.

clue.text: To east of river, nut changed direction to get cast away

indicators.note: to east of places the next piece to the right of the river, as on a map

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England

indicators.note: changed tells us the letters of nut are rearranged

explanation.surface: East of a river, a nut alters its course before being thrown away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Direction' looks like part of the nut's movement, but it is a stage direction; 'cast' is the actors, not a throw.
explanation.definitionFit: Exeunt is the Latin stage direction telling several actors to leave, so the cast goes off.

clue.text: Dominate, being most talented with spin?

parts.note: the best is the most talented
a spin is a short trip, a ride in a car

explanation.surface: Coming out on top by being the best at spinning.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestride something is to stand astride over it, so to tower over or dominate it.

clue.text: Scout in wild fen hid trap

indicators.note: wild suggests the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: In a wild marsh, someone has hidden a snare.
explanation.definitionFit: A pathfinder goes ahead to find the route, as a scout does.

clue.text: Iconic seals involved with church history, for instance

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled up together into a new order

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Iconic seals linked with church history are discussed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' reads as being connected with the church; it signals the jumble. CE, the Church of England, is a standard crossword abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: History is one example of a social science, a study of human society.

clue.text: One working under campaign's leader admitted to clumsy start

indicators.note: under, in a down clue, puts the following pieces below the previous ones
admitted to means that initial is let into the word for awkward

parts.note: inept means clumsy

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of campaign

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: A worker under the campaign chief is brought into a bungled launch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admitted to' puts C inside INEPT, making INCEPT; 'under' sets ION beneath it in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Inception is the beginning or start of something.

clue.text: Drink weary old man raised with uncertainty

indicators.note: raised, in a down clue, means the two words are read upwards

parts.note: to tire is to become weary
pa is an informal word for father, the old man
if expresses uncertainty, as in ifs and buts

explanation.surface: A tired old man doubtfully raises a glass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns TIRE PA upwards into APERIT.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperitif is an alcoholic drink taken before a meal.

clue.text: Intervening to take care of repair, brought about muscular action

parts.note: to parent a child is to take care of it

indicators.note: brought about means the word for mend is placed around the twitch

parts.note: to heal is to repair or mend
a tic is an involuntary twitch of a muscle

explanation.surface: Stepping in to look after repairs led to a muscle spasm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought about' places the twitch inside the word for mend, making HETICAL. 'Intervening' fits because a parenthetical remark interrupts the sentence around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A parenthetical remark is one inserted into a sentence, so it comes in between.

clue.text: Zero in under a tangled set of lines

indicators.note: in means the zero letter is set inside the rearranged word
tangled tells us the letters of under a are jumbled

parts.note: O looks like zero

explanation.surface: Zero inside a knotted collection of lines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tangled' turns UNDER A into RNDEAU, and 'in' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondeau is a short poem with a fixed pattern of lines and a refrain.

clue.text: Network consisting of fifty, Greek and English

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
Attic is the Greek dialect of Athens

explanation.surface: A network made up of fifty Greeks and English people.
explanation.definitionFit: A lattice is a criss-cross framework, a network of strips.

clue.text: Inverted piece fitted into arch comfortably

indicators.note: fitted into means the turned weapon goes inside the cunning word

parts.note: arch can mean knowing and sly

indicators.note: inverted, in a down clue, means the gun's letters are turned upside down

parts.note: a piece is slang for a gun

explanation.surface: An upside-down piece fits neatly into an arch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arch' looks like the curved structure; it is the adjective meaning roguish.
explanation.definitionFit: Snugly means in a cosy, comfortable way.

clue.text: Extract long hair, said to be what supplies power

indicators.note: said to be signals that the phrase is spoken and its sound gives the entry

parts.note: to wring is to extract by twisting, and a mane is long hair

explanation.surface: Pulling out long hair is apparently a source of energy.
explanation.walkthrough: A ring main is the loop of cable that feeds the sockets in a British house.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic electrical circuit wired in a loop delivers electricity to every socket on it.

clue.text: Cause of discoloration in jelly?

parts.note: read as a fungus that spots and stains food, or as the shaped vessel a jelly is set in

explanation.walkthrough: A straight definition with a cryptic hint: the fungus that discolours old food shares its name with the shaped vessel a jelly sets in.
explanation.definitionFit: A fungal growth discolours food, and the shaped container for a jelly bears the same name.

clue.text: Right child to receive trophy

indicators.note: to receive means the word for child takes the trophy inside

parts.note: a son is a child
a pot is slang for a sporting trophy or cup

explanation.surface: A child is given a trophy.
explanation.definitionFit: Spot on is a British idiom meaning exactly correct.

clue.text: Rock concert's opening piece of music

indicators.note: opening means just the first letter of concert

parts.note: a rag is a ragtime piece of music

explanation.surface: Concert opens with a rock music number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' looks like the music style; it is a stone outcrop.
explanation.definitionFit: A crag is a steep, rugged rock face.

clue.text: Secure bank — there's no run on it

indicators.note: there's no tells us the letter for run is missing from the word for row

parts.note: a tier is a bank or row, as of seats
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A safe bank: nobody is going to stage a run on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' and 'run' suggest a run on a bank, depositors rushing for their money; here bank is a row.
explanation.definitionFit: To tie something is to secure it with a knot or fastening.

clue.text: Stressing out? Quite the opposite with lackey around

indicators.note: around means the word for subordinate sits around the opposite of out

parts.note: an underling is a lackey or subordinate
the opposite of out is in

explanation.surface: Is it stressing out? No, the reverse, with a servant hovering nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: Underlining words emphasises them, so it means stressing.

clue.text: Institution's former collapse

definitions.meaning: the person who formed or established an institution
to give way or sink, as a ship or a plan does

explanation.definitionFit: The person who sets up a body, and the verb meaning to fail or sink, share one spelling.

clue.text: Cautiously left out what's hot and spicy

indicators.note: out signals that the letter for left is dropped from the word for carefully

parts.note: gingerly means cautiously

explanation.surface: Carefully set aside the hot, spicy food.
explanation.definitionFit: Gingery describes something tasting of ginger, which is hot and spicy.
